QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Eree Valley's Catch of the Day 1
QuestInfo.0: Pimi, the second oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. Her taste for seafood is second to none. Enlist her aid in assembling the fish patty.
QuestInfo.1: Pimi, the second oldest of the Pi siblings, is helping you and Simia pick out ingredients. Her taste for seafood is second to none. Enlist her aid in assembling the fish patty.\r\n\r\nPimi tells you to get Savory Fins from Green Catfish and Tart Fins from Blue Catfish.
QuestInfo.2: You made the fish patty with help from Pimi, the second oldest of the Pi siblings. It was a strange combination but it didn't taste half-bad. Time to add the finishing touches!

default.0: I see you haven't gotten all the ingredients yet. That's okay. We'll just have to make a smaller sandwich and maybe Muto'll starve I guess. No big deal.
